questions.text: "Fork" is the name of a person who's related by blood to "Knife" but not to "Spoon". Which two people could be identical twins with each other?
questions.why: Spoon cannot be an identical twin, because you cannot be related to one identical twin without being related to both.

questions.text: There's a drawer containing ten beads in four different amounts of four different colors. If there are twice as many red beads as white beads, and twice as many white beads as blue beads, how many green beads are there?
questions.why: The only way for there to be four different amounts that add up to 10 is 1+2+3+4. 3 is the only number that can't be twice or half of any of the other ones.
